key_insight: Symbal detects recurring captioning errors in multimodal models by finding image features that systematically trigger the same mismatch between image and text.
clinical_relevance: For clinical and medical imaging workflows, it could help audit AI-generated captions and surface hidden failure patterns before they affect downstream use or review.
method: Uses a dual-stage pipeline with off-the-shelf foundation models.
First identifies candidate systematic misalignments in vision-language datasets.
Then summarizes the detected error patterns in natural language.
evidence_signal: Evaluated on SymbalBench with 1.7 million image-text pairs across 420 datasets from natural and medical domains; Symbal correctly identified systematic misalignments in 63.8% of datasets, about 4× better than the nearest baseline.
watch_item: Performance is dataset-level and depends on available image-text pairs, so results may vary when captions are sparse, domains shift, or visual errors are subtle.
paper_title: Symbal: Detecting Systematic Misalignments in Model-Generated Captions
